## D — Licensing and required documents
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Commercial and motorcycle paragraphs, identification-card term lengths, historical REAL ID enforcement timing, fees and inconsistent license-duration statements are excluded from stable knowledge and explicitly retained as verification debt. Page seventeen contributes only REAL ID document content here; GDL content belongs in the next section.
Dynamic disposition: Fee amounts, license-duration conflicts, historical REAL ID dates and station-specific appointment instructions are withheld as debt; use current issuer evidence before asserting them.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.

corpus_stability.reason: This is a bounded snapshot of the issuer-linked Montana handbook. Its revision conflict is explicitly held as debt; there is no evidence in the supplied source of multiple substantive rewrites per year. Currency of individual changeable provisions is not inferred from this assessment.

verification_debt.claim_text: Page eleven basic-license term and page thirteen standard-license term conflict with age-based terms later in the chapter; no duration schedule is asserted.
Fee amounts and payment-channel information are changeable; verify against current official fee evidence before showing values.
Page eleven says some stations require appointments and lists renewal/replacement exceptions; page twenty says all stations require scheduled appointments. No general appointment rule is asserted.
Page thirteen mixes obsolete rollout dates and a later enforcement date; current federal travel applicability needs official verification.
Primary and secondary identity lists give overlapping expired-license windows. Preserve the listed categories without claiming they are mutually exclusive; issuer should reconcile applicability.
